prototype: ORBIT Prototype D v1.3.1 - Screen Observation & Evidence Fusion Engine

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Primary Screen Capture Accuracy
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Virtual desktop screen geometry queried via Win32 GetSystemMetrics.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Captured full desktop bitmap via GDI BitBlt + CAPTUREBLT with Per-Monitor DPI Aware v2.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Bitmap dimensions match virtual desktop bounds (2880x1800); 0 buffer leaks.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Measures GDI BitBlt transfer speed into Pillow 32-bit BGRA buffer.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: DPI Coordinate Normalization Contract
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Per-Monitor DPI Aware v2 context set at process initialization.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Mapped test client coordinate against live Win32 ClientToScreen ground truth.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Physical screen translation error is strictly <= 1.0 physical pixel.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: Accuracy confirmed: True, Error Distance: 0.00 px.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Mathematical rounding contract verified against native User32 ClientToScreen.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Foreground Window Detection
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Captured foreground window observation, PID, process name, and physical visible frame.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Valid HWND and extended bounds captured without drop-shadow distortion.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Extracts visible physical frame bounds excluding DWM drop-shadows.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Window Lifecycle & State Detection
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Extracted Z-order rank, Minimized/Maximized state, and visibility flags across desktop windows.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: All visible top-level windows enumerated in true Z-order without crashes.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Independent Accessibility Traversal
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Decoupled UIAutomationProvider and MSAAProvider dispatched independently via coordinator.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Traversed accessibility hierarchy for target HWND 3935208.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Independent ProviderResults generated; element provenance preserved.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: MSAA and UIA execute independently; failures do not cascade.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Traversal Watchdog & Soft Timeout
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Coordinator configured with watchdog soft timeout limit.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Executed traversal under constrained timeout budget.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Coordinator stops waiting at soft timeout; worker state marked ABANDONED_STILL_ACTIVE; no main thread hang.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: SOFT_TIMEOUT does not force-kill native blocked COM threads; worker marked abandoned.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Screen / Accessibility Alignment
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Physical window client rectangle bounds mapped to virtual screen capture space.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Cropped screen bitmap at client bounding rectangle.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Cropped image dimensions match physical client bounds exactly.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Validates physical pixel alignment between GDI screen bitmap and window geometry.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Multi-Dimensional Ground Truth Matching
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Multi-source fusion engine reconciling spatial containment, Z-order, and text agreement.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Fused screen capture bitmap with window metadata and accessibility nodes.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Produces structured DetectedTargets with explicit confidence levels.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: Fused Targets: 1, Overall Confidence: LOW_CONFIDENCE, Conflicts: 0.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Decomposes confidence into Spatial Agreement, Semantic Agreement, and Freshness.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Visual Change Detection (Layer V1)
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Layer V1 64-bit difference hashing (dHash) and perceptual variance evaluator.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Evaluated difference hash across baseline frame and modified visual frame.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: Change Detected: True (dHash Hamming Distance > Threshold).
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Visual change detection validates pixel deltas; does NOT infer semantic control changes.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Observation Freshness & Staleness (TTL)
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: FreshnessTracker with high-resolution timestamp TTL boundary.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Evaluated snapshot freshness at T0 and at T0 + delta_t (> TTL).
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Snapshot valid initially; declared STALE with reason TTL_EXPIRED after age threshold.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: Fresh Check: True (NONE), Expired Check: False (TTL_EXPIRED).
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Enforces mathematical time-to-live boundaries on historical desktop snapshots.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Rapid Focus Switching Invalidation
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Snapshot tagged with generation G; focus shift increments generation to G + 1.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Evaluated Snapshot Identity Validation against incremented desktop generation.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Snapshot declared STALE immediately; prevents reuse across focus shifts.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: Valid: False, Invalidation Reason: FOREGROUND_CHANGED, Generation Delta: 1.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Monotonic generation parity prevents action execution on historical focus states.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Window Destruction Invalidation
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Snapshot associated with closed or destroyed window handle (0xDEADBEEF).
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Evaluated Snapshot Identity Validation against destroyed target handle.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Detected IsWindow == False; snapshot declared STALE with reason TARGET_DESTROYED.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: IsWindow: False, Valid: False, Reason: TARGET_DESTROYED.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Prevents stale observation reuse when target application window terminates.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Human Takeover Invalidation Contract
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Prototype B takeover contract subscriber connected to FreshnessTracker.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Generation incremented; all historical snapshots invalidated; forced re-observation.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: Takeover Count: 1, Gen Delta: 1, Valid: False.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Validates decoupled architectural contract with Prototype B human takeover engine.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Multi-Monitor Architecture Support
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Simulated secondary display positioned left/above primary with negative coordinates.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Mapped negative accessibility bounding rectangle through CoordinateMapper.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Handles signed 64-bit coordinates without arithmetic underflow or clipping bugs.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Signed coordinate arithmetic validated; multi-monitor physical testing dependent on hardware.

test_cases_d1_to_d15.name: Contradiction & Occlusion Resolution
test_cases_d1_to_d15.setup: Target window element physically covered by overlapping foreground window higher in Z-order.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.action: Executed fusion engine spatial occlusion resolution algorithm.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.expected_result: Element marked is_occluded = True; confidence downgraded to CONFLICTING; explicit conflict logged.
test_cases_d1_to_d15.actual_observation: Occluded Detected: True, Confidence: CONFLICTING, Conflicts: 1.

measured_values.conflict_notes: Element 'Hidden Button' (PushButton) has GEOMETRIC OVERLAP with 'Top Occluding Window' (HWND 1002)

test_cases_d1_to_d15.limitations: Z-order bounding box intersection prevents false visibility assumptions on covered controls.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Genuine UIA Initialization
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Instantiate CLSID_CUIAutomation via CoCreateInstance on UIAutomationCore.dll.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Executed COM activation for IUIAutomation interface.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: CoCreateInstance returns S_OK (0x0) and valid interface pointer.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Validates direct COM client boundary with UIAutomationCore.dll.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Genuine UIA Tree Traversal
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: IUIAutomationTreeWalker dispatched across live target window hierarchy.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Traverses control view tree using genuine UIA TreeWalker.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Genuine UIA Property Retrieval
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Query IUIAutomationElement vtable properties (Name, ControlType, BoundingRectangle, ProcessId).
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Extracted structured UIElementObservation from root UIA node.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Valid properties retrieved without fallback or mock defaults.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Native property extraction mapped directly to physical coordinate Rect.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Evidence Source Separation
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: AccessibilityCoordinator dispatches Win32Control, MSAA, and UIAutomation providers independently.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Collected observation results from all 3 independent providers.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: All 3 providers emit distinct ProviderResult records with exact source tags.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Guarantees zero evidence relabeling or destructive overwriting across providers.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Accessibility Evidence Disagreement
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Inject contradictory element metadata across UIA and MSAA providers for same region.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Both contradictory observations are retained independently with exact provenance.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Verifies that fusion does not discard minority or contradictory provider evidence.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Real HWND Geometric Overlap
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Launch Window A and overlapping Window B in live Windows desktop environment.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Queried EnumWindows Z-order ranking and extended frame bounding boxes.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Validates Z_order(B) < Z_order(A) and bounding rectangle intersection.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Empirically verifies spatial overlap and visual Z-order on live HWNDs.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Controlled Visual Occlusion Evidence
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Capture screen bitmap with overlapping Window B; analyze covered ROI.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Covered controls marked is_occluded=True with explicit OcclusionState and CONFLICTING confidence.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Separates geometric intersection from screen-observed visual pixel occlusion.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Controlled Live Focus Switching
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Target window programmatically activated via SetForegroundWindow.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Observed live foreground transition via user32.GetForegroundWindow.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Accurately observes live foreground state and enforces snapshot invalidation.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Validates live foreground observation and generation tracking under OS activation rules.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Rapid Focus Switching Reality
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: High-rate programmatic focus toggles executed under high-frequency polling.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Measured requested vs observed switch frequency.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Accurately reports requested_hz != observed_hz without faking equality.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Proves that requested switch rate does not equal observed switch rate under Windows activation rules.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Foreground Generation Invalidation
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: ObservationSnapshot created at generation G; foreground transition increments generation to G+1.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Snapshot declared STALE immediately with reason FOREGROUND_CHANGED.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Enforces monotonic generation parity to prevent downstream action on stale focus.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Physical Monitor Topology Detection
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Discovered physical monitor count and virtual desktop geometry.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Accurately discovers monitor topology and physical bounds.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Live discovery of hardware display configuration.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: Negative Coordinate Validation
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Evaluate signed 64-bit coordinate mapping across secondary display origin.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Mapped negative accessibility rect through CoordinateMapper.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Signed integer underflow prevented; accurate bounding rect emitted.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Signed coordinate math validated; hardware physical validation conditional on >=2 displays.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: OCR Provider Capability Detection
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Probe NativeWinRTOCRProvider and OptionalTesseractOCRProvider runtime availability.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Queried is_available status across local OCR providers.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: Accurately reports whether local OCR runtimes are installed.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Probes native OCR DLL and Python package presence without failing pipeline.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.name: OCR Ground-Truth Accuracy
test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Controlled visual text target evaluated through DefaultOCRDispatcher.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Executed text recognition and accuracy comparison.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.expected_result: If available: Word accuracy >= 80%. If unavailable: Classified UNAVAILABLE honestly.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.actual_observation: OCR runtime unavailable in environment; decoupled fallback returned cleanly.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.limitations: Honestly classified as UNAVAILABLE when native OCR packages are absent.

test_cases_d16_to_d30.setup: Execute end-to-end multi-provider observation and fusion pipeline.
test_cases_d16_to_d30.action: Fused Win32Control, MSAA, UIAutomation, and Visual evidence for live window.
